description: Exploratory paired two-arm ablation of where the EB threshold-or-age qualification binds. Both arms run the adopted configuration (0.75 standard target, 10-block processed-block standard window, age-escape reset at certification). The adopted arm keeps the historical announcement-time qualification, under which the earliest below-threshold certificate lands one RB later than the specified certificate-inclusion rule allows. The qualify-at-cert arm implements the specified rule: a prudent producer announces one RB earlier, and certification enforces the qualification with the certifying RB counted. Ten paired seeds across the five headline loads plus the 0.1 tx/slot trickle (where the age escape binds) are intended as a directional smoke test, not confirmatory evidence.
